structured_payload.brief_summary: Athens is an unmaintained, open-source, collaborative knowledge graph application built primarily with Clojure, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Click, designed for teams to capture and synthesize knowledge using a graph database. It was available as a browser-based demo and a free desktop app. Users can adopt it by using the desktop app or the demo. Core public interfaces documented are @gmail.com and /summary.

Offered a browser-based demo (changes not saved) and a free, open-source desktop app.

bullets: The project is unmaintained.
Last release was v2.1.0-beta.5 on 2022-10-10.
v2.1.0-beta.5 included UI features like improved notifications and dark mode, alongside bug fixes and refactors.
Open issues at archival included dependency bumps, feature requests for TLS support (#2419), page-specific search (#2420), and an API for scripting (#2366).
Bug reports at archival included Safari compatibility (#2423) and Roam Research import failures (#2379).
Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct in place.
Code of Conduct enforcement handled by researchathens@gmail.com.

structured_payload.architecture_overview: Athens is an unmaintained, open-source, collaborative knowledge graph application designed for teams to capture and synthesize knowledge using a graph database. It is primarily written in Clojure (81.5%), with significant portions in TypeScript (15.8%) and JavaScript (1.7%). The project offered both a browser-based demo and a free, open-source desktop application, leveraging its multi-language stack to deliver a comprehensive knowledge management solution.
